Sources: [Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/china-proposes-adding-40-ai-biotech-solar-technologies-export-control-list-2026-10-16/) · [MOFCOM](https://www.mofcom.gov.cn/zcfb/dwmygl/art/2026/art_61446ab4beee4f63973d4d0ab3097648.html) · [Caixin](https://www.caixinglobal.com/2026-10-17/china-proposes-export-curbs-on-ai-and-solar-technology-102494151.html).

- **Primary window:** every body item except the two backfills was first announced or materially updated inside 2026-10-17T04:50:33Z–2026-10-19T04:50:33Z. DeepSeek's V4.1-Flash-1017 went live at 00:00 Beijing time on 17 October (16:00 UTC on 16 October) and is dated to its release day. Paper dates follow Hugging Face Daily Papers for 2026-10-19; several were first posted to arXiv on 13–16 October.
- **Backfill (2 items):** China's proposed export controls and StepFun's Step 5 Preview open weights, both dated 2026-10-16, fall before the primary window and were not covered in the two most recent briefings. Both are treated as recovery items under the pre-window rules; nothing else from the 2026-10-10–10-17 window was added.
- **Unverified / vendor claims:** DeepSeek, Mistral, Kyutai and StepFun benchmark, pricing and hardware figures are the companies' own unless an independent source is cited; Artificial Analysis figures for Step 5 Preview are independent. The Disney–Character.AI hiring terms, employee count and compensation estimates come from a bankruptcy filing as reported, not a company announcement, and require court approval.
- **Trimmed under limits (verified, not included):** Microsoft's withdrawal from Nscale's Loughton/Essex AI data centre over power delays (2026-10-18), San Francisco's signed 45-day data-centre moratorium (2026-10-16), the FAA's reported bid for an equity stake in AI air-traffic contractor Air Space Intelligence (2026-10-15), the OpenCode Console API-key breach tied to a "distillation attack" affecting ~1.4% of users (2026-10-17), Anthropic's draft federal AI-safety bill pitched to lawmakers (2026-10-16), Amazon's Atlas union-risk warehouse scoring (2026-10-16), the WSJ-reported gap between AI liability exposure and ~$50M insurance caps, and Meta's removal of an AI-training clause from its commercial terms (2026-10-17). Anthropic's Claude quantum-circuit and NIST ECDSA-seed research posts (both 2026-10-16) were also verified and left out.
- **Data limits:** GitHub star counts are from Star History as of 2026-10-19 UTC and move quickly; Product Hunt upvote counts measure attention, not adoption.

- **数据限制：** GitHub star 数为 Star History 在 2026-10-19 UTC 的读数，变化很快；Product Hunt 票数反映关注度，不代表实际采用。
